email.subject1: a signal play for Smith Micro
email.body1:
Anup, saw Smith Micro named a new CEO and pushed Q1 gross margin to 78.4%.

With a leadership transition and margin in focus, the pressure is usually on pipeline efficiency: cover more in-market accounts without growing the cost base. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Smith Micro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Anup, quick follow-up for Smith Micro.

When the focus shifts to efficient growth, every rep needs to produce more pipeline, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap surfaces late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Smith Micro needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Anup, last bit of proof for Smith Micro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Smith Micro's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Anup, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and I know a CEO transition keeps the calendar full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Smith Micro either way.
